mission: Design the smallest deterministic progress/throughput compiler from claims/runs/returns/integration/generation evidence. It must calculate real metrics from VERIFICATION_AND_CRITIC_CONTROL_V1 without inventing percentages, support time buckets and generations, expose critic-trigger conditions, and close currently uncomputable human-intervention metrics through a minimal durable event contract.
acceptance_criteria: time-bucket + generation canary and falsifiers explicit
write_scope: claim + own run + own return only

contradictions_surfaced: Published runtime epoch/packet trails current main head; use live main evidence for compiler inputs while treating runtime packet as architectural context, not current claim truth.
context_receipt.budget_estimate: Targeted exact read scope plus directory evidence; no full-repository scan.

planned_checkpoints: CP1 load exact progress-event and throughput specs plus live claims/runs/returns evidence
CP2 define deterministic event normalization and metric formulas with unknown/not-computable semantics
CP3 define minimal human-intervention/routing event contract
CP4 derive critic-trigger state machine and generation/time-bucket outputs
CP5 specify canary fixtures, falsifiers and acceptance evidence
CP6 persist evidence-backed RETURN and mark run DONE
